title: JBrowse config.json
description: The JBrowse 5.0.0-beta.13 config.json: assemblies, tracks, connections, site-wide configuration and a default session. Generated from the registered types by `pnpm autogen`.

$schema.description: The URL of this schema, so an editor can validate and complete the file.

JexlString.description: A jexl callback evaluated when the slot is read, e.g. `jexl:get(feature, "score") > 10 ? "red" : "blue"`. A slot takes one in place of a fixed value where its config docs list callback args.

JexlExpression.description: A jexl expression the display evaluates per feature, written with its prefix, e.g. `jexl:get(feature, "score") > 10`.

FeatureField.description: A field the display reads off each feature: a name, a dotted path into a structured field (`INFO.SVTYPE`), or a `jexl:` expression over `feature`, which the display evaluates per feature.

CssColor.description: A CSS color: a name like "red", "#rgb" / "#rrggbb" / "#rrggbbaa", "rgb()" / "rgba()" / "hsl()" / "hsla()", or a BED triple like "255,0,0"; "" for none. A field name is not a color; color by a field through the display's color channel.

CssColorEntry.description: A CSS color: a name like "red", "#rgb" / "#rrggbb" / "#rrggbbaa", "rgb()" / "rgba()" / "hsl()" / "hsla()", or a BED triple like "255,0,0".

showSashimiLabels.description: Draw the supporting-read count on each sashimi arc.

maxHeight.description: Maximum pixel height of the pileup layout; reads beyond this are not stacked (coverage still reflects true depth).

collapseGroupRows.description: Draw each group as a single row rather than a stack.

mismatchAlpha.description: Fade mismatch bases by their per-base Phred quality. Defaults to off.

fadeLowFreqMismatches.description: Fade the sub-pixel mismatches, insertions and clip bars in the pileup that fall below the depth-dependent frequency threshold; off draws them all at full opacity. Does not affect the coverage band (see runCoveragePipeline).

showLegend.description: Show the color-scheme legend overlay. Defaults to off.

sortedBy.description: Sort reads at a genomic position, e.g. by base, strand, or a tag (unset = unsorted). Any JSON value: the slot is `frozen`, so its shape is not checked here.

layoutOrder.description: Row order where no sort applies: by start (position), widest first (length), or spliced first (spliced).

unit.description: What one row stands for: a read, or a chain of a read, its mate and its split segments (the "View as pairs" menu row).

showBezierConnections.description: Draw paired-read connection curves over the pileup.

coverageHeight.description: Height of the coverage band in pixels.

coverageSnpMinFrequency.description: Hide a coverage-band allele segment whose share of that position's depth is below this fraction, so the band stops painting a sliver for every sequencing error at high depth. 0 (the default) colors every mismatch. showMismatches.description: Draw how reads differ from the reference: per-base mismatches, insertion markers and deletion bars. showInterbaseIndicators.description: Draw interbase insertion/clip count bars and indicator triangles.

flipStrandLongReadChains.description: Color split segments relative to the predominant orientation of the reads on screen, rather than by their own mapping strand.

showProperPairArcs.description: Draw arcs for ordinary concordant pairs. Uncheck to leave only the arcs that carry a category (abnormal insert size or orientation, split junctions), which on deep coverage is the difference between a readable band and a solid mass.

showModalPairsInCloud.description: Keep the pairs of ordinary insert size in the read cloud, as the band the abnormal pairs are read against.

minInterchromSupport.description: Hide inter-chromosomal connections supported by fewer than this many reads clustered at the same breakpoint.

readConnections.description: Read-connection rendering mode (mate pairs + split reads).

readConnectionsDown.description: Draw read connections below the coverage band. Defaults to on.

minSashimiScore.description: Hide sashimi arcs with fewer than this many supporting reads.

sashimiArcsHeight.description: Height of the sashimi-arc band in pixels.

readConnectionsHeight.description: Height of the read-connection band in pixels.

showSoftClipping.description: Draw soft-clipped read portions. Defaults to off.

value.description: the color of every alignment in place of the default scheme.

field.description: what colors an alignment: strand paints forward and reverse; query and target one color per sequence on that side, reference one per chromosome of the anchor assembly across a stack, track one per overlaid track (pinned under Track colors); identity, mapq and dnds paint the preset ramps; any other name is a column the tracks declare in attributeColumns, a ramp over the values seen for numbers and one color per label for text (or the color a color column put beside it).

scale.description: none paints value and keeps the field for a switch back; unset, a field paints.

domain.description: a text column's labels that take the palette first, in order, and lead the key, the rest following sorted; a label left out takes a color no listed label or label met before it paints, the first time the view meets it, and keeps it.

range.description: CSS colors a text column's labels take, in domain order, continuing into the default palette past its end; with no domain, each label takes one of them by its name; on a ramp (identity, mapq, dnds or a numeric column), its stops, evenly spaced, in place of the field's own.

scheme.description: a named ramp for a linear or log scale; range's colors, where it lists any, win over it.

reverse.description: turns a linear or log scale's ramp round, so its last color paints the bottom of the domain.

domainMid.description: the value the ramp's middle stop sits at, so a diverging ramp centres somewhere other than the middle of the domain, both sides on one scale: the farther end of the domain reaches its end color and equal distances from the middle take equal colors; unset, the stops are evenly spaced across it.

domainMin.description: the bottom of a linear or log scale's domain; unset follows the loaded values.

domainMax.description: the top of a linear or log scale's domain; unset follows the loaded values.

labels.description: what the key names each domain value, one each in order, or under threshold each interval from the lowest; one past the list keeps its own name.

title.description: key title; unset keeps the display's own heading, "" draws none.

value.description: every alignment's opacity; unset is the view's default.

field.description: measurement or attributeColumns column; empty is value.

scale.description: none, threshold, or unset to follow the field.

domain.description: labels, or threshold cut points.

domainMin.description: value at the faintest end; unset follows the field.

domainMax.description: value at the most opaque end; unset follows the field.
